notes.title: Game Will Now Continue Development!
notes.content: [hr][/hr][p]Hello! Thank you to any playtesters that requested and participated in this week's playtest build! With this playtest week out of the way, the game's development can now continue with the inputs in mind. Though unfortunately, the amount of feedback the playtest build got was, putting it lightly, less than expected, so the feedback form will also be available in the demo version. [/p][p][/p][p]Either you are playing the demo in here or itch, there will be access to send feedback in the bottom left button in the main menu. Will highly appreciate any feedback, and also keep in mind I will be dealing with any feedback more dynamically now since I will be doing it while developing the last leg of the game instead waiting around for any inputs to come in, so things may get noticed and worked on slightly slower.[/p][p][/p][p]On other news surrounding the game, Pokitaire seems to now have it's very first Steam curator! They have a clip of them playing through the tutorial, which is nice to see! Again, just like Playtesters, it's nice to see anyone external giving notice to this game![/p][previewyoutube="jvlaZxoWfTA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Game's Playtest Now Active!
notes.content: [p]Hello and welcome playtesters! All of you that request for playtesting throughout the weekend will now have access to the playtest version of the game! If my memory serves me right, it should be on the version [i]v1.6.1[/i]. So feel free to play, break, and play and break the game and give me the feedback I desperately need.[/p][p][/p][p]Remember the access will only last[/p][h3]From the 15th to the 19th Sept![/h3]

notes.title: Game Now Needs Playtesters!!
notes.content:
[p]Hello! Game's release is only around a month later now and the progress on the game is [i]very[/i] close to being done. But before that day comes, comes the polish and fixing any obvious bugs, but as the creator, my eyes has narrowed too much on what could possibly go wrong when playing my game, so I would need [b]YOU![/b] person reading this to help me out.[i]
[/i][/p][p]If you go to the Steam store page now there should be a button to join the playtest! Once you are in it, you will be able to play the nearly completed version of this game and you can either play it like you own it, try and purposely break it, or play in a mysterious third way. But importantly, after you think you've sufficiently played it to form any feedback or face any issues, head to the 'Send Feedback Here' button placed in the main menu and in the final ending screen, which will bring you into a form where you can send your feedback and issues with the game!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/89e4e01d936f00c43a5055aecfbecc148d28178a.png"][/img][/p][p]
I am planning to keep the playtest open until I feel I have sufficient responses, but at minimum, it'll be open for a week. Obviously, I would prefer if every person that will be joining this playtest would be trying to help out and send feedback instead of just trying to get the full game early, but clearly I can't stop anyone for doing either. So I'm just hoping that [b]you[/b] dear reader will be helping me out![/p][p]Anyway, the demo versions is still getting a few changes in this update. The most significant one being, fixing a bug where 'Checkered' skin would be unlocked prematurely, and the exit game button hides itself now when any other menu is opened so no one accidentally presses it. Anyway, that's all! See you in the playtest![/p]

notes.title: Game Now has a Release Date!!
notes.content:
[p]Hello! Some bug fixes has been made to the demo of Pokitaire, mainly related to how cards aren't fully disabled when the game is paused or not in play.[/p][list][*][p]Fix bug of being able to deal cards when no cards are selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug of being able to break Tutorial Deck's script via quick dealing[/p][/*][*][p]Selected cards are now deselected when game is paused[/p][/*][/list][p]Ok, with that out of the way, now for the marketing updates. It has been decided;[/p][h2]Pokitaire will be released at Oct 21st 2025!![/h2][p]The full game will be both available here and [url="https://zepphy.itch.io/pokitaire"]itch.io[/url] in around 2 months, so mark your calendars! If you're wondering what the progress of the full game is looking like, believe it or not, ever since version 1.3, I've been purely working on the finale of the game. The nature of this game's difficulty curve comes from decks becoming more and more complicated and I have been trying my best to keep the code future proof as the decks gets more complicated, but lets just say the finale has my future proofing defeated and a lot of time is now being spent rewriting massive parts of the game to support to ever increasing complexity of the final decks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/e2375ac752205c96715096943e87ce3813cae455.gif"][/img][/p][p]Progress, even though slower than usual, is still going fine and two months should be more than enough redundancy if any other detours arise. In the meantime, y'all should try out the demo and wishlist the game as usual, if you don't want to do the usual, then you should check out my GMTK 2025 game jam entry "The EAPTT Initiative"! It's a platformer I made in 4 days, and to be honest, I did pretty bad! Position wise. But unlike my 3 other GMTK jam entries, I do like this game enough that I would love to work on it more, so I might update it to polish it, since I didn't get the chance to do that in the 96 hours, or The EAPTT might be the next game after this one 👀.
[url="https://bsky.app/profile/zepphy.bsky.social/post/3lviycvwoh22v"]
[/url][url="https://zepphy.itch.io/the-eaptt"]Try "The EAPTT Initiative" here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, that's all for today's marketing devlog! Hope you enjoy the new update and the new game and see y'all in the next one![/p]

notes.title: Game has 100+ Wishlists!!
notes.content: [p]Hello! We have yet another marketing related devlog! This time is to celebrate the milestone of the Steam version of the game reaching 100+ wishlists! As time of writing this, there are specifically 115, which is way more than my initial expectation of like.. 5, so thank you all for that! Perhaps we can reach higher, maybe 150? or even 250?! Regardless, this milestone may be small compared to other games on Steam, but it is a big milestone specifically for this one![/p][p]Also this game has been featured in [url="https://playtester.io/pokitaire"]playtester.io[/url]! Which is a website that lists alphas, betas, and demos for upcoming games. Personally, I have some doubts if being featured in this website will help me much because of its seemingly small notoriety, but I don't think it matters much for me, it's just nice to featured by something/someone external.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/b40f926c764994e218497f4d735ac8957c8b6ddd.png"][/img][/p][p]Anyway, there are some bug fixes that I did to justify this devlog and there is one that is significant enough to talk about. There is this bug in the game for some time where a card will suddenly jump above an opened menu, and for most of the time I consider it as a non-issue as it seemingly looks like it effects nothing but make the game look slightly less polished. But then at some point I figure out how to break my own game using this bug making it from a non-issue to a very yea-issue, so it is fixed now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/747f08c8710219ac01ab7f817eec4c7e7b4d3b40.png"][/img][/p][p]Anyway, that's all! Again, thank you for the support and hope it will reach more people as time goes on![/p]

notes.title: Game Now has Skins!
notes.content: [p]Hello! Pride month is unfortunately coming to an end, but not for the skin because the game now has a skins system! You now get to choose different variants of the front face. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/3b79aeb5b7d21cdc570f01da827ab0d0dd203735.png"][/img][/p][p]Right away, everyone should have three skins available (Default, High Contrast, and Pride). To unlock the other two, will require the player to complete specific objectives. The amount of skins for now is very limited, but the full version later on will have way more and the objectives will also function as achievements! So they are going to require some elbow grease to complete.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/4b11542618bf7df12da471ac45701f76e73fcd92.png"][/img][/p][p]There's also a few bug fixes and QoL additions, the major ones are mainly for the Steam version, like being able to properly close the game and an actually working display settings. To be honest, working on this feature is cutting time from the development of the full version, but it should be fine because I was planning to add achievements eventually and this seems like a fun way to implement it, also a good to way to reward the ones that buys the game on itch later on, since they wouldn't have the Steam achievements.[/p]

notes.title: This Game's Demo is On Steam Now!
notes.content:
[p]First Steam post, how exciting! This post will be for anyone that has stumbled this game purely on Steam, instead of my itch.io page. This game has actually been in development for around 11 months, in itch.io there has been more than a dozen devlog posts detailing the process of making the game. But from this point onwards, all you Steam users too will receive the same devlog posts I am putting on itch. So, welcome! And thank you for checking out Pokitaire![/p][p][/p][p][i]Latest itch.io post starts here[/i][/p][p]♠♤♥♡♣♧♦♢♠♤♥♡♣♧♦♢-------------------------------------------------♠♤♥♡♣♧♦♢♠♤♥♡♣♧♦♢[/p][p]Oh wow! An actual promotional related devlog! I'm not sure if I was looking at a legacy option on Steam or something, but it turns out it cost free to make a demo for your game, so the demo's also there now!![/p][p][/p][p]The version you will get there will be the same as the one in this website (version 1.4.3d). So there will not be much difference except display options and the convenience of playing on Steam. While making the demo store page it also [i]requires[/i] a trailer to be put in there, so for the sake of it we also have one! This is something definitely overdue so Steam forcing me to make one is a good thing mostly.[/p][previewyoutube="4SM21LMLiro;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The progress on the game has, unfortunately, not been very good, it's been very slow and I can't even admit its because of this promotional stuff. But things should be on track soon again, I have on my agenda that the demo version will get another update in the end of this month, so look forward to that :).[/p][p][/p][p]On a personal note, yesterday was my birthday! I would post all of this on the day, but Steam doesn't let you publish things on weekends for some reason. So yes I am an ancient age of 23 now and I feel... exactly the same, so that's fun! I remember a few months ago, the initial agenda was for the full game to be done by [b]today[/b], but.. yeah I'm definitely not reaching that. In the worst case scenario, the game will be done by the end of this year, but hope that wouldn't be the case, because that is a while away. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505767/864bf839b377d26d08662fda547bbb0c2a5c4967.png"][/img][/p]
